Container.Name: XPUBVAULT
Container.Overview: Offline, watch-only wallet viewer: paste an xpub, a descriptor or an address and it derives, verifies and keeps every address in an encrypted vault. It never accepts a private key and works with the network cable unplugged. Before the first start, own the appdata folder by the container's UID: chown -R 10999:10999 /mnt/user/appdata/xpubvault && chmod 700 /mnt/user/appdata/xpubvault
Container.Requires: Before the first start, in a terminal: chown -R 10999:10999 /mnt/user/appdata/xpubvault && chmod 700 /mnt/user/appdata/xpubvault — and again after Unraid's New Permissions tool, which makes shares readable by everyone and so is refused. The container prints this command whenever it finds the folder wrong.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface port (HTTPS, with a certificate the container generates: compare its fingerprint with the one in the log).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Vault, database and config. Must be owned by the container UID (10999 by default) with no group or other access; the container prints the exact chown command if it is not.

Config.Name: Mode
Config.Description: AIRGAP: no balances, nothing leaves. LOCAL: balances from a server you run on your network (Electrum or Fulcrum, Bitcoin Core, Blockbook, an EVM node). PUBLIC: from public explorers too, such as mempool.space; needs Allow PUBLIC = 1. On a bridged network AIRGAP is enforced by the application only, and the UI says so; for isolation by the network itself, see the README. LOCAL is needed for a Tang server.

Config.Name: Allow PUBLIC
Config.Description: 1 lets Mode PUBLIC be chosen at all: balances from public explorers, which then learn every address they are asked about, and this server's address. Choosing it still asks for a confirmation in Settings. 0 keeps PUBLIC out of reach.

Config.Name: Keys
Config.Description: OPTIONAL keyfile for unattended starts, and the widget key when the dashboard projection is on. Must be a DIFFERENT DEVICE from appdata: an Unassigned Devices USB stick, or a tmpfs filled at array start from somewhere that is not the flash drive. A folder under /mnt/user/appdata sits on the same disks and inside every appdata backup, and is refused.

Config.Name: Keyfile
Config.Description: OPTIONAL: the keyfile's name under /keys (e.g. xpubvault.key) to unlock with at every start. Refused if it sits under /data or is readable by group or other.

Config.Name: Tang at start
Config.Description: 1: unlock at every start through the vault's Tang servers (added in Settings; needs Mode LOCAL). Fails safe: locked when no Tang server answers.

Config.Name: Host names
Config.Description: OPTIONAL: names you open the WebUI by, comma-separated, for the certificate (IP addresses always work).
